hero.title: Straight Talk.
hero.subtitle: From a quick oil change to a check-engine light that won't quit, A-1 Auto Repair gets you back on the road fast — with upfront pricing and work you can trust.

highlights.title: Upfront, Honest Pricing
highlights.text: You get a clear estimate before we touch a thing. No surprise add-ons, no upselling repairs you don't need — just straight answers and a fair price.

highlights.title: Quick Turnaround
highlights.text: We know you've got places to be. Most routine services are done the same day, so you're not stuck waiting on your car any longer than you have to.

highlights.title: Quality Work, Done Right
highlights.text: We fix it right the first time using quality parts and careful workmanship — because a repair that lasts is the only kind worth doing.

highlights.title: Accurate Diagnostics
highlights.text: Modern scan tools plus old-school know-how mean we pinpoint the real problem instead of guessing — so you only pay to fix what's actually wrong.

about.heading: About A-1 Auto Repair
about.lead: We're the neighborhood shop that treats your car like it's our own — and treats you like a neighbor, not a number.
paragraphs: A-1 Auto Repair is an independent, family-owned shop that has been fixing cars right here in DeKalb since 1982. We built this place on a simple promise: tell people the truth, charge a fair price, and do the work right. No corporate quotas, no pressure to sell you repairs you don't need — just honest mechanics who explain what's going on in plain English and let you make the call.

Whether you're an NIU student trying to get through finals without a breakdown, a family keeping the daily driver going, or someone who just wants a mechanic they can finally trust, you'll get the same straight answers and quality work every time. Bring us your car, and we'll get you back on the road fast — and back to your life.

about.heading: Sobre A-1 Auto Repair
about.lead: Somos el taller del barrio que trata tu carro como si fuera nuestro — y te trata como vecino, no como un número.
paragraphs: A-1 Auto Repair es un taller independiente y familiar que repara carros aquí mismo en DeKalb desde 1982. Construimos este lugar sobre una promesa sencilla: decirle la verdad a la gente, cobrar un precio justo y hacer el trabajo bien. Sin cuotas corporativas, sin presión para venderte reparaciones que no necesitas — solo mecánicos honestos que te explican qué pasa en palabras claras y te dejan a ti decidir.

Ya seas estudiante de NIU tratando de pasar los exámenes finales sin que el carro te falle, una familia que mantiene andando el carro de diario, o alguien que por fin quiere un mecánico de confianza, vas a recibir las mismas respuestas directas y el mismo trabajo de calidad siempre. Tráenos tu carro y te regresamos al camino rápido — y de vuelta a tu vida.
